Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is it from the coverage of this game. The action of the Oman Quadrangular T20I series continues on 13th February 2022, where Ireland will take on United Arab Emirates. Initially, there was no game scheduled on Sunday but since, the first fixture between them got postponed due to logistical issues, the game is rescheduled to be played on Sunday. The action of the rescheduled fixture will begin at 11:30 am IST (6:00 am GMT). But as you all know the build-up will begin in advance. Do join us for that. Till then, goodbye and take care!

Andy Balbirnie the skipper of Ireland and also the MAN OF THE MATCH. He says that it's good to start the tournament with a win and they really enjoyed playing in Oman and he thought they bowled well and restricted Oman to a low score. Mentions that the guys are feeling good and they are looking forward to the qualifiers as well. States that he really enjoyed batting with Paul Stirling, and they got off to a good start as well.

Zeeshan Maqsood, the skipper of Oman, says that they got a good start but failed to carry in the end. Mentions that they needed a good total against a team like Ireland but failed to put up a show. Tells that they have to see where they went wrong and come back stronger. Adds that they have a day to rest and they will look forward to win the next game.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

A perfect performance from the Irish, they were right on the money with the ball, excellent in the field and they were clinical with the bat as well. Andy Balbirnie and Paul Stirling gave Ireland the desired start, they put together 103 runs and guided their side closer to victory. Paul Stirling did perish after a sublime knock of 51 but Andy Balbirnie stuck till the end and took Ireland over the line with ease. They have put on a dominant show and will look to carry on the same way.

Oman will be disappointed with their performance. Their batting was a concern again today as they managed to put a below-par total of just 137. They failed to deliver with the ball as well. They had no answers to the brilliant batting shown by the Irish. Khawar Ali did grab the big wicket of Paul Stirling but it was all too late by then. They have lost both their games and now the hosts have a lot to think about for the next game.

A comprehensive win for Ireland! They were in full control of the chase and have began this series with a win under their belt. Oman once again failed to put on a show with bat and the bowlers did not have much to defend. They have lost their second game in a row and will look to make amends and come back stronger.
SIX! BANG! The Irish skipper finishes things off in style! Short ball, on middle. Andy Balbirnie stands tall and swivel-pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a maximum. Ireland win by 9 wickets!
Full and on middle, driven back to the bowler.
On a good length, on off Gareth Delany defends it to the off side.
Full and on the pads, pushed to long on for a brace.
On a length, on off. Andy Balbirnie steers it to deep cover for a run.
A low full toss, on off. Andy Balbirnie drives it towards covers. The fielder there dives to his right and stops the ball.
Touch fuller, on off. Gareth Delany drives it to wide of long off for a single.
Floats it up, on the pads. Played down to long on for a single. Just 8 runs needed now!
Floats it up, on off. Andy Balbirnie looks to work it on the leg side. The ball goes off the outside edge to third man for three runs.
Loopy ball, on middle. Andy Balbirnie reverse-sweeps it to cover.
On the pads, Andy Balbirnie works it through mid-wicket now for a couple of runs.
This is clipped to mid-wicket as well but for a single.
Flighted ball, on middle. Delany tucks it to the vacant mid-wicket region for a brace.
Fuller ball, on middle. Gareth Delany eases it down to long on for a single. He retains the strike!
A low full toss, on middle. Andy Balbirnie knocks it to long on for a single.
Slower ball, on a length, around middle and leg. Gareth Delany taps it towards mid-wicket and takes a quick single.
Shorter ball, around middle. Andy Balbirnie pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! High and handsome! Fuller ball, around middle. Andy Balbirnie makes room and tonks it way over long off for a biggie! Ireland inching closer to victory now!
Length ball, around middle. Gareth Delany pushes it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball, full and on middle. Gareth Delany pushes it towards long on for a single.
Shorter ball, outside off. Andy Balbirnie taps it to point for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! Fuller ball, outside off. Andy Balbirnie drives it past cover for a cracking boundary.
Tossed up, on off. Gareth Delany pushes it to long off for a single.
Gareth Delany walks out to bat.

OUT! STUMPED! Khawar Ali strikes, but maybe it's a little too late now. Oman finally have their first wicket! A leg spinner, around off. Paul Stirling steps down the track and looks to go big, but he misses as the ball turns away from him. The keeper collects the ball and whips the bails off in a flash. End of a fine innings by Paul Stirling!
Commentary.Howout: st Naseem Khushi b Khawar Ali

Commentary.Commentary: FIFTY for Andy Balbirnie as well! Flatter ball, on middle. Andy Balbirnie knocks it to long on for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Andy Balbirnie pushes it past cover for a single.
Very full, around middle. Paul Stirling lifts it over towards long on. A single taken!
Much fuller, outside off. Andy Balbirnie squeezes it towards cover for a single.
FIFTY for Paul Stirling! He has been in sublime form and continues to impress here as well! A low full toss, on middle. Paul Stirling knocks it to long on for a single.
Beaten! A slower ball, outside off. Paul Stirling stays back and looks to cut it away but misses.
Length ball, around middle. Andy Balbirnie knocks it to long on for a single.
Fuller, on middle. Andy Balbirnie eases it down to long off for a single.

Byes! Sharp spin!  A loopy ball, fuller in length. Paul Stirling leans and looks to push this away but gets beaten as the ball turns away from him. The keeper fails to collect it as well. A bye taken!
Shorter ball, around off. Andy Balbirnie slashes this towards point for a single.
Flighted delivery, around middle. Paul Stirling leans and eases it down to long on and rotates the strike.
Loopy ball, full in length, around middle. Andy Balbirnie knocks it to long off for a single.
Flatter ball, around middle. Stirling pushes it towards cover for a single.
FOUR! Perfect execution! A fuller ball, on middle. Andy Balbirnie gets low and sweeps this towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Fuller and outside off. Paul Stirling drives it towards deep cover for single.
Outside off, shorter this time. Paul Stirling cuts it towards point.
SIX! BANG! A loopy ball, full and on middle. Paul Stirling makes room and smokes it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Shorter, around off. Andy Balbirnie pushes it towards long off for a single.
Tosses this one up, full and on middle. Paul Stirling sweeps it towards long on for a single.
Ayaan Khan comes to bowl now.
Full and on off, Paul Stirling eases it down to long off for a single. At the halfway mark, Ireland are 78/0. 60 needed from 60 balls.
On the pads, tucked to deep square leg for a single.
On middle, eased down to mid on for a single.
SIX! SMOKED! Loopy ball, on middle. Paul Stirling stays back and tonks it just over the long on fielder for a maximum.
Short and on off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tosses it up, on middle. Pushed down to long on for a single.
Khawar Ali comes into the attack now.
Fuller, on middle. Paul Stirling clears his front leg and pushes it to mid on for a single.
On a good length, on off. Driven to mid off.
Length ball, on middle. Andy Balbirnie lifts it to sweeper cover. He crosses ends.
On a good length, on off. Paul Stirling steers it to deep point for one.
Short of a length, on off. Paul Stirling looks to heave it away but fails to get any bat onto it.
On a length, on middle. Paul Stirling keeps it out.
Flatter ball, on off. Stirling works it to the off side and is happy to take the single.
This is pushed towards covers for a single.
Short and outside off, cut to deep point for a single.
SIX! SMACKED! Floats it up, on middle. Paul Stirling stands tall and muscles it all the way over long on for a biggie.
Short and on off. Stirling punches it towards covers.
Loopy ball, on off. Balbirnie sweeps it to short fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Brilliant yorker from Fayyaz Butt, on off. Paul Stirling tries to dig it out but gets lucky. The ball goes off the outside edge and races away to the third man fence.
Short of a length, on middle. Andy Balbirnie pulls it to deep square leg for one.
A yorker, on middle. Paul Stirling pushes it to mid on. He crosses ends.
Bangs a short ball, outside off. Paul Stirling looks to pull but fails to connect.
On a length, on leg. Andy Balbirnie tucks it on the leg side for a single.
Good-length ball, outside off. Pushed towards covers.
Flatter ball, outside off. Paul Stirling pushes it to the off side. End of the Powerplay, Ireland are 47/0.
On off, blocked out.

DROPPED! Loopy ball, on middle. Andy Balbirnie steps out and lifts it towards covers. The fielder spills it out. A single is taken. It was a straightforward catch but the fielder made a meal out of it.
FOUR! Floats it up, on middle and leg. Andy Balbirnie gets low on one knee and sweeps it hard past mid-wicket for another boundary.
On off, cut to point.
FOUR! Elegant shot! Loopy ball, on off. Andy Balbirnie makes room and drives it through extra cover and mid off for a boundary.
Zeeshan Maqsood comes into the attack.
Shorter now, around off. Paul Stirling stays in his crease and taps it to the fielder at mid-wicket. Dot to end the over!
Length ball, around middle. Andy Balbirnie tucks it towards square leg for another single.
Fuller, on the pads. Andy Balbirnie tucks it away past square leg fo a brace.
Tad shorter, outside off. Paul Stirling taps it to point and rotates the strike.
Length ball, around middle and leg. Andy Balbirnie taps it towards square leg for a single.
Good-length ball, around middle. Paul Stirling nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fayyaz Butt is brought into the attack.
Length ball, outside off. Andy Balbirnie taps it to point. Dot to end the over!
FOUR! The skipper on the charge! Another top shot! Perfect timing again. A shortish ball, around middle. Andy Balbirnie backs away and pushes it past cover once again for a boundary.
Back of a length, outside off. Andy Balbirnie cuts it towards the fielder at cover-point. No run taken!
Length ball, around middle. Andy Balbirnie works it away towards mid-wicket. Dot ball!
FOUR! Wonderful shot! Back of a length, outside off. Andy Balbirnie stands tall and pushes it past cover for a boundary.
Touch shorter, around middle. Paul Stirling looks to defend but he gets an under-edge towards the right of the keeper and scampers through to the other end.
Shorter ball, around middle. Andy Balbirnie looks to pull this but misses and gets hit on the ribs. Dot ball.
A low full toss, around off. Andy Balbirnie pushes it towards point.
SIX! BOOM! First six of the innings! On a length, around middle. Andy Balbirnie steps down and heaves it way over long on for a biggie!
Back of a length, outside off. Andy Balbirnie knocks it to the fielder at mid off.
Length ball, outside off. Paul Stirling looks to drive but gets an outside edge towards third man for a single.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Good-length delivery, outside off. Paul Stirling pushes it past cover for a boundary.
FOUR! Andy Balbirnie gets off the mark in style! On a length, outside off. Andy Balbirnie makes room and slashes it over cover fo a boundary.
Shorter ball, around off. Andy Balbirnie taps it to the fielder at cover-point. Dot ball.
Length ball, around middle. Paul Stirling tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tad fuller, on middle. Paul Stirling blocks it out solidly.
Back of a length, outside off. Paul Stirling taps it to the fielder at over. No run there!
FOUR! Glorious shot! Touch shorter, outside off. Paul Stirling stands tall, guides it past point for a boundary.
Kaleemullah to bowl from the other end.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Paul Stirling taps it towards point and takes a single. 3 runs off the first over!
Leg bye! Length ball, around middle and leg. Andy Balbirnie looks to tuck it away but misses and gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards fine leg and the batters steal a leg bye.
Beaten! Beautiful delivery! Tad shorter, outside off. Andy Balbirnie looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Fuller ball, around off. Andy Balbirnie drives it to the fielder at mid off.
Length ball, on the pads. Paul Stirling tucks it to square leg for a single. Ireland and Paul Stirling are up and running!
